bio_en: Sedrak Jalalian, known as Seto, was born on 3 December 1884 in Chamurlu near Aparan into a patriarchal family of Basen refugees, and studied at the Russian gymnasium in Yerevan. In the 1905 Armenian-Tatar clashes he fought in the front line, and Nikol Duman sent him to the Etchmiadzin district. After studying physics and mathematics in St Petersburg in 1906-08, he was arrested on dangerous party work and exiled to Siberia for five years (1908-13), returning with a mammoth skeleton for his university and qualifying in law in 1917. Under the Republic he served as a band leader, governor of Etchmiadzin district and police chief of Yerevan; he died on 14 October 1961.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high. Dates 3 Dec 1884 - 14 Oct 1961 from the title.
